plan.title: SRC-TNC-050 Default Terms in T&C Modal

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ, matching the scenario.
Provide the required event title for a valid create-screen flow.
Choose the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet and event terms controls are available.
Add the specified CYLINDER product and quantity 10; the product selection supplies its default Variant 1.
Set the requested delivery location on the first line item.
Confirm the requested delivery location was selected.
Open the event-wise Terms & Conditions modal.
Confirm that the Terms & Conditions modal opened.
Verify the modal identifies the current event terms section.
Verify the company's standard default terms are shown when configured.
